onboarding.title: Welcome to MoodSort
onboarding.intro: MoodSort is a visual tool to help you explore your emotions.
onboarding.step2: Move the cards around to represent what matches how you feel today.
onboarding.step3: Stack cards on top of each other to form a pile, name it, and move the cards together.
onboarding.step4: Undo or redo your latest actions, or reset the positions.
onboarding.step6: Share the layout of your cards with someone.
onboarding.outro: There is no right or wrong way to place the cards. Group them however helps you explore your emotions.
onboarding.privacy: 🔒 Your data stays private: everything you do in MoodSort stays on your device and nothing is ever sent or stored elsewhere, unless you turn on layout sharing: the person who joins you can then see the layout of your cards.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetPositionsDescription: Reset the layout of all cards to the center of the screen.
settings.confirmResetMessage: All cards will return to the center.

screenShare.title: Share the layout
screenShare.description: Turn on sharing to let another person follow the layout of your cards live, in read-only mode.
screenShare.shareLinkPrompt: Share this link with the person you want to invite:
screenShare.copyUnsupported: Automatic copying is not available in this browser. Copy the link manually.
screenShare.unsupported: Your browser does not support layout sharing.
screenShare.statusStopped: Sharing stopped: no one connected in time. Click "Turn on sharing" to try again.

screenShareViewer.unsupported: Your browser does not support layout sharing (WebRTC unavailable).
